title: D. N Problems During K Days

legend: Polycarp has to solve exactly n%%ZSMJ0%% problems to improve his programming skill before an important programming competition. But this competition will be held very soon, most precisely, it will start in k%%ZSMJ1%% days. It means that Polycarp has exactly k%%ZSMJ2%% days for training!

Polycarp doesn't want to procrastinate, so he wants to solve at least one problem during each of k%%ZSMJ3%% days. He also doesn't want to overwork, so if he solves x%%ZSMJ4%% problems during some day, he should solve no more than 2x%%ZSMJ5%% problems during the next day. And, at last, he wants to improve his skill, so if he solves x%%ZSMJ6%% problems during some day, he should solve at least x+1%%ZSMJ7%% problem during the next day.

More formally: let [a1,a2,…,ak]%%ZSMJ8%% be the array of numbers of problems solved by Polycarp. The i%%ZSMJ9%%-th element of this array is the number of problems Polycarp solves during the i%%ZSMJ10%%-th day of his training. Then the following conditions must be satisfied:
sum of all ai%%ZSMJ11%% for i%%ZSMJ12%% from 1%%ZSMJ13%% to k%%ZSMJ14%% should be n%%ZSMJ15%%;
ai%%ZSMJ16%% should be greater than zero for each i%%ZSMJ17%% from 1%%ZSMJ18%% to k%%ZSMJ19%%;
the condition ai<ai+1≤2ai%%ZSMJ20%% should be satisfied for each i%%ZSMJ21%% from 1%%ZSMJ22%% to k−1%%ZSMJ23%%.
Your problem is to find any array a%%ZSMJ24%% of length k%%ZSMJ25%% satisfying the conditions above or say that it is impossible to do it.
input: The first line of the input contains two integers n%%ZSMJ26%% and k%%ZSMJ27%% (1≤n≤109,1≤k≤105%%ZSMJ28%%) — the number of problems Polycarp wants to solve and the number of days Polycarp wants to train.
output: If it is impossible to find any array a%%ZSMJ29%% of length k%%ZSMJ30%% satisfying Polycarp's rules of training, print "NO" in the first line.

Otherwise print "YES" in the first line, then print k%%ZSMJ31%% integers a1,a2,…,ak%%ZSMJ32%% in the second line, where ai%%ZSMJ33%% should be the number of problems Polycarp should solve during the i%%ZSMJ34%%-th day. If there are multiple answers, you can print any.
